rationale: Completes the sparse-trim finding with its protective counterpart: unlike trim, the snapshot path bounds compaction only by the local decided index and never consults the minimum accepted index, so a snapshot-capable entry type can still compact a sparse-pid configuration. Recorded as a source-level behavior so the defect account's scope (trim API, not all compaction) rests on a cited mechanism.

knowledge.statement: SequencePaxos::snapshot passes its index to InternalStorage::try_snapshot, which accepts any index less than the local decided index (equal maps to the decided index without the StopSign) and rejects only indices greater than decided with UndecidedIndex. It performs trim, compacted-index and snapshot writes atomically and never consults the minimum accepted index. The snapshot API is therefore not affected by the sparse-pid placeholders that block trim, so a snapshot-capable Entry type can still compact a configuration such as {1,2,5}.
knowledge.conditions: A snapshot-capable Entry type (Snapshot::use_snapshots() true) and a snapshot index not greater than the node's decided index; the node may be a follower when local_only is true.
